button: Balance optical padding and icon alignment across tones and sizes; preserve width when loading.
Verify Enter/Space, disabled/loading suppression, focus visibility and non-submitting default inside a form.
Exercise long and multiline labels, icon-only names and full-width mobile actions.
button-group: Define shared edges, separators and spacing for mixed action lengths.
Keep grouping semantics without changing the native behavior of its buttons.
Wrap or stack on narrow containers without splitting labels or hiding actions.
aspect-ratio: Keep the requested ratio without stretching media or shifting nearby layout.
Define object-fit, image loading/error and meaningful alt behavior in documented compositions.
Test portrait, landscape, very narrow parents and content with intrinsic minimum width.
avatar: Review crop, initials, optical centering and size variants in groups.
Verify image failure and source changes restore the correct fallback.
Ensure an accessible name without duplicate announcements in labeled compositions.
badge: Tune compact typography, inset spacing and icon/text alignment.
Verify semantic state labels and light/dark contrast without color-only meaning.
Test long status labels, wrapping and placement beside controls.
card: Define anatomy for header, description, body, footer and action alignment.
Test interactive content without turning unrelated areas into accidental click targets.
Review single-column and grid compositions with mixed content lengths.
direction: Propagate text direction and logical spacing into nested components.
Verify portaled overlays and navigation use the intended RTL direction.
Test mixed LTR/RTL text, icons and controls in constrained layouts.
empty: Make absence understandable with a useful next step and measured visual hierarchy.
Distinguish no data, no search results, permission limits and error recovery.
Test long explanations and primary actions on mobile.
item: Align leading content, title, description and trailing actions consistently.
Avoid nested interactive conflicts and give trailing actions explicit names.
Stack metadata and actions when the available width becomes insufficient.
kbd: Balance keycap typography, border and baseline within text and controls.
Use real keyboard semantics and document platform-specific shortcut labels.
Test multiline shortcut hints and high contrast.
progress: Make value, label and track visually consistent; handle zero and completion.
Clamp invalid values and expose determinate or indeterminate status correctly.
Test long labels, reduced motion and updates without disruptive announcements.
separator: Use spacing and contrast appropriate to horizontal and vertical grouping.
Distinguish decorative separators from meaningful semantic separators.
Verify flexible layouts and bounded vertical sizing.
skeleton: Match realistic final-content proportions and avoid distracting layout shifts.
Keep loading shapes out of the accessibility tree while the parent announces loading.
Test reduced motion, different content lengths and dark surfaces.
spinner: Balance stroke, size and baseline with nearby text and buttons.
Expose a concise loading status without repeated announcements.
Provide equivalent static feedback with reduced motion.
typography: Review optical weight, tracking, line height and heading/body hierarchy.
Preserve semantic heading levels and readable link/focus treatments.
Test 200% text zoom, long words, narrow measure and font fallback.
alert: Distinguish informative, successful, warning and error states through text and structure.
Use appropriate announcement urgency and avoid duplicate live-region messages.
Test long content, links and recovery actions on mobile.
calendar: Refine month header, weekday alignment, day grid, selection and range states.
Verify keyboard navigation, disabled dates, today, month boundaries and accessible date names.
Test dense touch targets, narrow containers, locale-length text and dark mode.
checkbox: Align box, label, help text and indeterminate/checked/disabled states.
Preserve explicit IDs, label activation, form value and caller event behavior.
Test multiline labels, Field errors, keyboard and touch.
combobox: Provide clear query, selected value, active option, empty and loading states.
Verify typing, arrow keys, Enter, Escape, pointer selection and announced active option.
Constrain the popup to viewport/container and retain usability in a modal.
date-picker: Design input, selected date, clear action and calendar surface as one control.
Verify manual entry, invalid dates, locale presentation and keyboard selection.
Test mobile keyboard, narrow popover placement and Field error association.
field: Make label, description, required marker, control and error a consistent anatomy.
Associate IDs and descriptions with the actual control across Input, Select and custom controls.
Test asynchronous errors, multiline hints and 200% text zoom.
input: Review text, placeholder, caret, border, focus and invalid state without excessive decoration.
Preserve native type, autocomplete, form submission, refs and caller handlers.
Test long values, autofill, mobile keyboard, disabled and readonly.
input-group: Align prefix, suffix, icon and action content without shrinking the input excessively.
Preserve input labeling and ensure addon actions do not submit accidentally.
Test narrow containers, long prefixes, error focus and touch controls.
input-otp: Design readable digit entry, selection, focus and invalid state.
Verify paste, deletion, arrows, autofill, numeric constraints and completion events.
Test screen-reader naming, mobile keyboard and long codes without overflow.
label: Keep label typography and spacing consistent with required/help indicators.
Preserve association to native and compound controls, including explicit IDs.
Test activation, multiline text, disabled context and narrow layouts.
native-select: Refine spacing and alignment while respecting platform control behavior.
Preserve selected, disabled, required and invalid semantics in forms.
Test long options, mobile picker behavior and Field descriptions.
radio-group: Balance control, label and supporting text in vertical and card variants.
Verify one selection, form values, explicit labels and arrow-key navigation.
Test disabled choices, long descriptions and touch targets.
select: Design trigger, placeholder, selected text, list, active and disabled options.
Forward Field IDs and error attributes to the trigger; verify keyboard and typeahead.
Check collision handling, long lists, scroll and nesting inside overlays.
slider: Align track, thumb, labels and value feedback across orientations.
Verify keyboard steps, bounds, range thumbs and pointer interaction.
Test touch alternatives, label announcements, disabled state and narrow layouts.
switch: Define clear on/off visual states with stable label alignment.
Preserve controlled/uncontrolled values, IDs, form semantics and keyboard activation.
Test multiline labels and adequate touch area without oversized visual geometry.
textarea: Review text rhythm, placeholder, resize affordance and error placement.
Preserve native input/form behavior and support controlled values.
Test long content, mobile keyboard, resizing and minimum/maximum height.
toggle: Give pressed and unpressed states equal clarity without relying on color alone.
Verify aria-pressed, keyboard activation and disabled behavior.
Test icon-only labels and touch sizing in toolbar compositions.
toggle-group: Define spacing and selected appearance for single and multiple selection where supported.
Document selection mode and verify arrow navigation and state changes.
Wrap or scroll intentionally on narrow containers without losing selected context.
alert-dialog: Make consequence, cancel action and confirmation hierarchy unmistakable.
Verify safe initial focus, focus containment, Escape/cancel and explicit confirmation.
Test long descriptions, loading confirmation and short mobile viewports.
dialog: Refine title, description, body, close action and optional persistent footer.
Verify initial focus, focus trap, Escape, outside interaction and return focus.
Test nested controls, long scrolling content, mobile keyboard and safe areas.
drawer: Define mobile sheet anatomy, handle/close affordance and action placement.
Verify dismissal, focus management and non-drag alternatives for any gestures.
Test tall content, keyboard appearance, orientation changes and nested controls.
hover-card: Make supporting information legible with stable placement and restrained motion.
Keep essential actions/content available without hover.
Verify pointer transition, focus alternatives, collisions and narrow screens.
popover: Align trigger and content with predictable padding and dismissal.
Verify focus behavior, Escape, outside press and interactive child controls.
Test viewport collisions, long content and nesting inside a dialog.
sheet: Define edge placement, header, body and footer across sizes.
Verify document scroll handling, Escape and focus restoration.
Test safe areas, keyboard, small heights and nested popups.
toast: Design title, description, action, dismissal and multiple-notification placement.
Expose reusable data/state rather than fixed demo copy; verify announcement timing.
Test pause/dismiss, repeated messages, reduced motion and mobile safe areas.
tooltip: Tune delay, placement, contrast and concise content.
Verify keyboard/focus availability and dismiss behavior; keep essential content outside tooltips.
Test viewport edges, touch expectations, disabled triggers and long labels.
accordion: Align headings, indicators and expanded content with consistent rhythm.
Verify keyboard controls, expanded state and the selected expansion mode.
Test long headings, nested forms and reduced motion.
breadcrumb: Distinguish current page, ancestors and separators without visual noise.
Preserve ordered navigation semantics and meaningful link names.
Collapse or wrap long hierarchies intentionally on mobile.
collapsible: Provide a clear trigger and measured reveal spacing.
Verify expanded state, keyboard and focus when content disappears.
Test long hidden content and reduced motion without layout breakage.
command: Design query, result groups, active item, shortcut hints and empty state.
Use unique IDs; verify arrow keys, Enter, Escape, disabled results and focus return.
Test large result lists, no results, mobile keyboard and scroll-to-active behavior.
context-menu: Design grouped actions, separators, destructive and disabled entries.
Support keyboard context-menu invocation and predictable focus restoration.
Provide an accessible touch alternative and verify viewport-edge collision.
dropdown-menu: Define grouped actions, icons, shortcuts, submenus and destructive states where supported.
Verify keyboard navigation, disabled items, selection and focus return.
Test long labels, scroll, touch and trigger/menu placement inside overlays.
menubar: Align top-level menus and nested action lists.
Verify horizontal/vertical arrow navigation, Escape and disabled actions.
Handle narrow widths without inaccessible hidden commands.
navigation-menu: Design active links, grouped content and responsive navigation.
Preserve link semantics and predictable keyboard behavior.
Test mobile disclosure, long labels, nested content and real destinations.
pagination: Make position, total, previous/next and edge-disabled states clear.
Handle zero/one/many pages, page changes and announced position.
Test large page counts and mobile layout without squeezing controls.
scroll-area: Provide clear scroll affordances without obscuring content.
Verify keyboard scrolling, focusable descendants and nested scroll behavior.
Test both axes, long content, touch and bounded dimensions.
sidebar: Design active item, groups, collapsed mode and content alignment.
Preserve navigation semantics, focus and state across expansion.
Use a mobile-first drawer/disclosure pattern without hiding essential destinations.
tabs: Balance active indicator, labels and panel spacing across densities.
Verify roving focus, arrow keys, Home/End and panel association.
Test overflow, long labels, controlled state and mobile access.
carousel: Design media/content, indicators and navigation as a coherent composition.
Verify keyboard, previous/next bounds and accessible slide announcements.
Support touch where declared and avoid inaccessible autoplay or page overflow.
chart: Tune axes, palette, legends, tooltips and chart-area rhythm across supported types.
Provide accessible data alternatives and interaction without mouse-only information.
Test empty/small/large series, narrow widths, dark mode and reduced motion.
data-table: Design toolbar, header, cells, selection, status and pagination consistently.
Verify filtering, sorting, selection and actions with accessible state.
Handle empty results, long cells and mobile columns or bounded horizontal scrolling.
resizable: Make the handle visible and preserve useful minimum pane sizes.
Verify pointer resizing and keyboard/non-drag alternatives with announced values.
Test touch, narrow parents, orientation and content overflow.
table: Refine caption, headers, row rhythm and numeric alignment.
Preserve table semantics and clarify interactive row actions.
Test long cells, empty data, zoom and bounded horizontal scrolling.
attachment: Design filename, type, size/status and remove/download actions where supported.
Give actions explicit names and avoid accidental parent form submission.
Test long filenames, upload/error states and mobile target sizing.
bubble: Define incoming/outgoing alignment, readable measure and content spacing.
Keep author and message meaning available without color-only distinction.
Test long words, links, code and narrow containers.
marker: Separate time or state boundaries with quiet but legible hierarchy.
Use appropriate semantics without repetitive live announcements.
Test long labels and narrow conversation widths.
message: Align author, metadata, content and actions without visual clutter.
Preserve meaningful timestamps, action labels and message semantics.
Test long content, attachments and narrow layouts.
message-scroller: Maintain readable spacing and intentional scrolling in conversation history.
Respect user scroll position while new content arrives; avoid forced jumps.
Verify keyboard access, live-region behavior and short mobile viewports.
questionnaire: Design progress, question, choice, help and navigation as one task.
Verify required/optional/conditional steps, backward navigation and preserved answers.
Test validation, long choices, mobile keyboard, final submission and error recovery.
